description: List every Quebec municipality where Gas Quebec tracks gas stations, as name + slug pairs (the city_slug the price tools take). Names only, no prices. Use it when the user asks which places are covered, or when search_locations cannot match a place. Coverage is the province of Quebec only; prices come from Régie Essence Québec (Régie de l'énergie du Québec).
name: list_cities
title: List tracked Quebec cities
